ai_summary: Adani Total Gas Limited has announced a Board Meeting for October 22, 2026, to approve its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with a subsequent investor call on October 23rd to discuss performance and business outlook. This is a standard corporate disclosure, accompanied by the routine closure of the trading window from October 1st to October 25th for designated persons, ensuring regulatory compliance. The document indicates no material negative impacts or red flags, simply signaling the upcoming release of financial information.
